title: HTTP3: Guarantee unique offsets for the header data
description:
Don't just use the offset in the current subset tvb,
use tvb_raw_offset() as well. Go further and cover
the case where there are multiple QUIC packets in the
same frame, and even in the same QUIC layer (thanks to
coalescing.)

Fix #19474
